topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Ran into an old friend today, or so they claimed. Met an old teddy bear, more like, at a yard sale. Stuffed to the seams with memories, I guess. The thing had that worn-out, almost-sorry look, like a faded photograph, the kind you keep in a drawer you never open. They said it brought back times when the world was bigger and friendlier, full of secrets just waiting to be found under every rock. Not so much of that left now. People, they get eaten up by the city, by the years, by whatever’s waiting in the shadows. This bear, though, it’s seen better days, just like all of us. Some things stay, even when they shouldn’t.
